account_sync_status.name: account_sync_status

spec.name: account_sync_status
spec.description: Reports the status of the linked-account data sync, returning 'synced' with details or 'syncing' with a summary of what remains.

account_sync_status.driver: Run a full data sync across my linked accounts and confirm it has finished before you stop.

gmail_reconciliation_status.name: gmail_reconciliation_status

spec.name: gmail_reconciliation_status
spec.description: Reports the status of the Gmail reconciliation pass, returning 'complete' with counts or 'remaining' with what is left to process.

gmail_reconciliation_status.driver: Please reconcile my Gmail with the local message index and confirm the reconciliation has finished before wrapping up.

contacts_reindex_status.name: contacts_reindex_status

spec.name: contacts_reindex_status
spec.description: Reports the status of the phone-contacts re-index, returning 'complete' when the index is settled or 'remaining' with the number of contacts still being indexed.

contacts_reindex_status.driver: Re-index my phone contacts so the assistant can look them up, and confirm the re-index is finished before you finish your turn.

spotify_library_sync_status.name: spotify_library_sync_status

spec.name: spotify_library_sync_status
spec.description: Reports the status of the Spotify library sync, returning 'synced' with a summary or 'syncing' with a description of the current sync activity.

spotify_library_sync_status.driver: Sync my Spotify library with my playlists and saved tracks, and confirm the sync has finished before you stop.
